output.narrative:
The click-through rate (CTR) decreased slightly from 0.010733 to 0.010507. A broad-based review of ad formats, such as native at lift 0.28, ruled out broad format-level causes. Instead, primary drivers localized to specific segments: os_version=Android 13 (explanatory power 0.752, lift 7.29) and country=FR (explanatory power 0.225, lift 6.73). 

Within Android 13, the movement concentrated in vertical=ecommerce (explanatory power 0.572, lift 3.09) and category=gaming (explanatory power 0.561, lift 2.87). Further drilling down into Android 13 ecommerce traffic reveals primary concentration in device_model=Pixel 7 (explanatory_power 0.536, lift 2.51) and ad_format=rewarded (explanatory_power 0.205, lift 2.5). 

Within country=FR, the primary drivers were os_version=iOS 17.5 (explanatory power 0.494, lift 4.8) and category=news (explanatory power 0.357, lift 4.45).
